 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_VAL IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(5); 
 X NUMBER (7);
 Y NUMBER (7);
 ADD_DAT DATE ;
 H_DAT DATE ;
 RET NUMBER;
P_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 P_CURR_PORT_CD NUMBER;
BEGIN 
P_PORT_CD := :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD;
IF :P_PORT_CD IS NULL THEN
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD;
ELSE
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := :P_PORT_CD ;
END IF;

/*IF :P_IMP_NO IS NULL THEN
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1, 130,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;*/


SELECT COUNT (1) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS( 
SELECT DCLTN.DCLTN_NBR 
FROM
SD_PORTS SDP,
IMPORTERS IMP,
DECLARATIONS DCLTN,
HARMONIZED_TARIFF L_HT,
TARIFF_DETAILS L_TRFD,
DCLTN_ITEMS DCLTN_IT
WHERE
 (DCLTN.IMPR_NBR = :P_IMP_NO OR :P_IMP_NO IS NULL)AND
 (DCLTN.PORT_CD = P_CURR_PORT_CD OR P_CURR_PORT_CD IS NULL) AND
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 (L_HT.HRMNZD_CODE = :P_HRMNZD_CODE OR :P_HRMNZD_CODE IS NULL )
 AND (DCLTN.LIC_TYPE = :P_LIC_TYPE OR :P_LIC_TYPE IS NULL )
 AND (DCLTN. LIC_NBR = :P_LIC_NBR OR :P_LIC_NBR IS NULL )
 AND (DCLTN_IT.CTRY_CD = :P_CTRY_CD OR :P_CTRY_CD IS NULL ) AND
 
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DCLTN_IT.BRKR_TARIFF_CD = L_TRFD.HRMNZD_CODE AND
DCLTN_IT.BRKR_TARIFF_DT = L_TRFD.EFF_DATE AND
L_TRFD.HRMNZD_CODE = L_HT.HRMNZD_CODE AND
DCLTN_IT.PORT_CD = DCLTN.PORT_CD AND
DCLTN_IT.DCLTN_ISN = DCLTN.DCLTN_ISN AND
DCLTN.PORT_CD = IMP.PORT_CD (+) AND
DCLTN.IMPR_NBR = IMP.IMPR_NBR (+) AND
DCLTN.PORT_CD = SDP.PORT_CD
AND (DCLTN.DCLTN_DT BETWEEN (:START_DT) AND (:END_DT) OR :START_DT IS NULL AND :END_DT IS NULL)
AND DCLTN_IT.CSTMS_COST IS NOT NULL
AND DCLTN_IT.INV_CIF_COST IS NOT NULL);
---------------------------------------------------

IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 -----------------
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_LIC_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_LIC_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_LIC_NBR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CTRY_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_CTRY_CD); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_HRMNZD_CODE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_HRMNZD_CODE);
 ----------------
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_IMPR_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_IMP_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'START_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'END_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,P_PORT_CD);
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER, :REPORT_NO);
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER, :parameter.P_MODULE_NAME);
 
 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 


ELSE
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1, 100,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

END ;

PROCEDURE PRINT_CHECK_VAL IS

IF :P_PORT_CD IS NULL THEN

ELSE

/*IF :P_IMP_NO IS NULL THEN

SELECT COUNT (1) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS( 
SELECT DCLTN.DCLTN_NBR 
FROM

IMPORTERS IMP,
DECLARATIONS DCLTN,
HARMONIZED_TARIFF L_HT,

WHERE

DCLTN_IT.BRKR_TARIFF_CD = L_TRFD.HRMNZD_CODE AND
DCLTN_IT.BRKR_TARIFF_DT = L_TRFD.EFF_DATE AND
L_TRFD.HRMNZD_CODE = L_HT.HRMNZD_CODE AND
DCLTN_IT.PORT_CD = DCLTN.PORT_CD AND
DCLTN_IT.DCLTN_ISN = DCLTN.DCLTN_ISN AND
DCLTN.PORT_CD = IMP.PORT_CD (+) AND
DCLTN.IMPR_NBR = IMP.IMPR_NBR (+) AND
DCLTN.PORT_CD = SDP.PORT_CD
AND (DCLTN.DCLTN_DT BETWEEN (:START_DT) AND (:END_DT) OR :START_DT IS NULL AND :END_DT IS NULL)
AND DCLTN_IT.CSTMS_COST IS NOT NULL
AND DCLTN_IT.INV_CIF_COST IS NOT NULL);

IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN

 END IF;

 WIN_API_DIALOG.SELECT_PRINTER(P_NAME , P_PORT , TRUE );
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESNAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,P_NAME); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER, :REPORT_NO); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_IMPR_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_IMP_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'START_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'END_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 

 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER, :parameter.P_MODULE_NAME);
 
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 


ELSE
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1, 100,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
END ;
